name: Mon Petit Avis
author: Alexis

sections.description:
Mon Petit Avis is a WooCommerce plugin that connects your online store to the Mon Petit Avis service, a French platform for collecting and managing certified customer reviews.

Main Features

  • Automatic product synchronization: Your WooCommerce products are automatically sent to Mon Petit Avis
  • Automatic review requests: After each order, a review request is automatically sent to the customer
  • Product image management: Your product images are synchronized for better rendering
  • Simple configuration: Only one API key required to get started
  • Bulk import: Import all your existing products with one click
  • WooCommerce compatible: Works with the latest versions of WooCommerce

Why Mon Petit Avis?

  • French solution: Data hosted in France, GDPR compliant
  • Certified reviews: Guarantee the authenticity of your customer reviews
  • Intuitive interface: Simple management from your Mon Petit Avis dashboard
  • French support: A team ready to help you in French

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • A Mon Petit Avis account (create one at mon-petit-avis.fr)
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Setup

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Create an account on Mon Petit Avis
  3. Get your API key from your business account settings
  4. In WordPress, go to WooCommerce > Mon Petit Avis
  5. Enter your API key
  6. Import your existing products (optional)

That’s it! Your new products and orders will be automatically synchronized.

Support

For any questions or issues:
* Documentation: Mon Petit Avis Documentation
* Support: Contact us

Privacy Policy

This plugin sends the following data to Mon Petit Avis (https://api.mon-petit-avis.fr):

Product data:
* Product name
* SKU (reference)
* Status (active, draft, archived)
* Product image

Order data:
* Customer email
* Customer first name
* Customer last name
* SKUs of ordered products

This data is necessary for the Mon Petit Avis service to function. See the Mon Petit Avis privacy policy for more information.

External Services

This plugin communicates with the Mon Petit Avis external service:

  • Service: Mon Petit Avis API
  • URL: https://api.mon-petit-avis.fr
  • Usage: Product synchronization and order data submission
  • Data sent: Product information (name, SKU, image) and customer data (first name, last name, email)
  • Terms of service: https://mon-petit-avis.fr/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://mon-petit-avis.fr/privacy

Using this plugin implies acceptance of the Mon Petit Avis terms of service.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Mon Petit Avis”
  4. Click Install Now then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Select the downloaded ZIP file
  4. Click Install Now then Activate

Configuration

  1. Go to WooCommerce > Mon Petit Avis
  2. Enter your Mon Petit Avis API key
  3. Configure your synchronization preferences
  4. Save your changes
sections.faq:
Do I need a Mon Petit Avis account?

Yes, you must create an account on mon-petit-avis.fr to get your API key.

Is the plugin free?

The WordPress plugin is free. Mon Petit Avis offers different subscription plans according to your needs.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all communications with the Mon Petit Avis API are encrypted via HTTPS. Data is hosted in France and GDPR compliant.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Synchronization stops, but your data remains accessible on your Mon Petit Avis account. You can reactivate the plugin at any time.

Are reviews displayed on my site?

The plugin handles sending data to Mon Petit Avis. To display reviews on your site, consult the Mon Petit Avis documentation regarding display widgets.

Does the plugin work with variable products?

Yes, the plugin synchronizes all types of WooCommerce products, including variable and grouped products.

Can I import my existing products?

Yes, use the “Import now” button in the settings to send all your existing products to Mon Petit Avis.
